description: This file defines the PersistentStorage class, which provides an interface for storing, retrieving, and managing data in localStorage with support for expiration and namespacing. It is part of the typeahead.js library by Twitter.

classes.name: PersistentStorage
classes.description: A class for managing namespaced localStorage data with optional TTL support.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from localStorage, considering expiration.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in localStorage with optional TTL.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific key and its TTL from localStorage.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all keys matching the namespace pattern.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if a stored key has expired based on TTL.
